reader_summary.headline: Throughout most of my career, the S&P 500 has been an appropriate bogey to assess manager performance.
reader_summary.overview: Throughout most of my career, the S&P 500 has been an appropriate bogey to assess manager performance. More than that, it's the most widely used benchmark in the capital markets. But today, it doesn't represent the broad-based, diversified exposure to the U.S.

key_points.text: economy that most participants take for granted when investing passively or measuring manager skill.
This WTT, When the Benchmark Becomes a Bet, considers the evidence, implications, and challenges posed by the current composition of the S&P 500.
